findings.tp_fp_justification: lrh2000's counterexample: the blanket `unsafe impl<G> AtomicModeGuard for G where G: BorrowAsAtomicModeGuard {}` is unsound because BorrowAsAtomicModeGuard is a safe trait; a FakeGuard whose as_atomic_mode_guard is todo!() (or returns a fake guard) satisfies it, defeating the atomic-mode guarantee. Author agrees to remove (2011537030/2011544998), tatetian concurs. Defect is the blanket impl at L82-86, comment anchored at L79.
